background: Monmouthshire Building Society is a small mutual based in Newport, funded by retail savings from its branches in south-east Wales and the border counties and lending on residential mortgages.
synthesis: The society holds no public rating from any of the three main agencies, so a depositor has only the reported figures to go on. Capital is thin by building-society standards, with CET1 of 14.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.6% below the median. Liquidity is adequate rather than generous: LCR of 170% is in the bottom quarter while NSFR of 145% sits at the median. The one flagged item, on 19 Aug 2026, is a fall in lending while its mortgage platform was upgraded, which slows growth but does not touch its capital.
